what: Drag the photo cell row sideways and it follows the hand (past either end it follows at half speed, like a rubber band). On release it slides at that speed and snaps to the cell nearest to where it would stop. Each frame (60fps) adds (target − position) × .025 to the velocity, adds that to the position, then multiplies the velocity by (1 − .28) — the original Flickity physics — so it is dragged slowly at first and then eases to a stop (a one-cell advance takes a bit over 1s). The prev and next buttons move one cell at a time (with group: fit, by the group of cells that fit on screen), and fade out at both ends

options.attraction: Pull toward the target (per Frame), default .025 — other bands in the original use .1 (sticks faster)
options.friction: Per-frame shrink speed ratio, default .28 — other bands in the original use .5
options.threshold: Minimum distance counted as a drag (px), default 3 — 30 for the article strip
options.group: ‹fit› passes the group of cells that fit on screen as one panel (groupCells: true). Without it, one cell at a time
options.[data-fx-part=viewport]: Clipping frame for overflowing cells (the element itself if none)
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Cell row (required) — each child is one cell
options.rewind: When 1, the buttons rewind from the end to the start and from the start to the end (no fade at either end) — imitates the original wrapAround strip with buttons. Default 0
options.wrap: When 1, the button loops from the end to the start and from the start to the end — it moves cells of the opposite-end panel over so it travels only one panel (the original wrapAround button hop). Dragging stops at both ends. Default 0
options.fx:goto: Fire an fx:goto(detail.index) event on an element to pull it to that cell — for picking from outside, like a row of number buttons

use: — When the cell changes, the element gets fx:select(detail.index)
note: Drag wrapAround (continuing to pull out past the last slide) is not supported, so it stops at both ends. Button paging uses wrap: 1 (continuous loop) and rewind: 1 (rewind). Only horizontal drag is captured, and vertical swipes scroll the page.

from.where: index.html .r-carousel (original .carousel-wrap .carousel, Flickity default physics .025·.28, three cells), article.html top photo band (original .top-carousel — default physics · group fit · wrap)
